title: No test writes the operator's real ~/.ticfac/registry
description: eih added a registry redirect for internal/cli, but the full -short gate on epic/2jn (2026-09-27 09:2x) still left seven entries in the real ~/.ticfac/registry, pointing at deleted temp dirs: TestRunStartsDetachedAttachesAndResumesForReal, TestRunAcceptsTheRunIDSpellingOfTheEpicID, TestTheBareOverviewJSONEmitsTheSameModel, TestStatusJSONNamesADegradedTracker, TestStatusReportsTheWallClockFiringOfAnInFlightAttempt, TestWatchStartedWhileTheRunHoldsReportsTheHoldItJoined, TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote. They show up in the bare 'ticfac' overview as phantom runs. Every package whose tests start or register a run must point the registry at a temp dir, and a guard should fail when a test run leaves the real registry changed.
notes:
2026-09-27 12:20 - ticfac run epic-2jn: 7ag try 1 (run dispatch #23) reported a finding the run itself decided — defect "Merging tick 9sz will break the build: internal/cli gets a second TestMain" (key 33a9290dfc0daed1ca806d785cec349f1028a4d2bec512ef4913e914863c0826, severity medium, for this repository) is absorbed into the running epic as tick 5bd, with nobody triaging; the decision record is on the run branch at .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/33a9290dfc0daed1ca806d785cec349f1028a4d2bec512ef4913e914863c0826.json, and the draft is triaged as promoted.
2026-09-27 12:25 - ticfac run epic-2jn: 7ag try 1 (run dispatch #23) merged into epic/2jn as 17ff5150ae02; the integrated gate (go, ts) passed.
acceptance_criteria: After go test -short ./..., the real ~/.ticfac/registry is byte-for-byte unchanged (a guard asserts it); every registering test uses a temp registry
